title: Every cloud resource is deployed from Git
description: Ryan's rule (2026-11-11): nobody creates a cloud resource by hand. Every resource is defined in Git and applied by a pipeline on merge to main (GitHub Actions + OIDC, public repo). Agents use the AWS CLI to read, never to create or change. One exception: the first apply of the pipeline's own wider role cannot come from a pipeline that does not exist yet. Also adopts the resources that were made by hand (the Route 53 zone, the budget, the deploy role stack). Design in project/wiki/infrastructure-pipeline.md. Secret values (the two SSM SecureString parameters) are the person-only exception.
